scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && vite build client
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test shared/test/rules.test.ts server/test/auth.test.ts server/test/bot.test.ts server/test/e2e.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "tsc -p server --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc --noEmit -p client && tsc --noEmit -p shared/test && tsc --noEmit -p server/test
